facts.fact: Cliffe Dekker Hofmeyr says section 16 of the Cybercrimes Act 19 of 2020 criminalises disclosing intimate images without consent and extends to simulated images, so a deepfake is not exempt, and the Electoral Act 73 of 1998 prohibits publishing false information meant to influence elections.
Cliffe Dekker Hofmeyr says on 18 March 2026 that South Africa has no single law dedicated to AI or deepfakes and has yet to announce specific AI regulation proposals.

Cliffe Dekker Hofmeyr says the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies has released a National AI Policy Framework signalling a future risk-based regulatory model, with no adoption by cabinet stated.

ZAF.note: No locally built AI model, dataset or compute stated.

facts.fact: Cliffe Dekker Hofmeyr says the Cybercrimes Act 19 of 2020 criminalises the electronic disclosure of intimate images without consent under section 16.
Cliffe Dekker Hofmeyr says the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 prohibits processing personal information without a lawful basis and section 99 lets victims claim damages.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013
